title: Implement GAIA-style task suite
summary: 实现 GAIA 风格综合任务评估，覆盖多步推理、工具协作和 evidence-aware completion。
requirement: Implement a GAIA-style benchmark suite that can score exact or quasi-exact task completion and preserve evidence for multi-step assistant tasks.
acceptance: scoring supports exact and quasi-exact match
case results preserve completion evidence and failure reasons
